name: smwmusic-touhou-koumakyou-the-embodiment-of-the-scarlet-devil-septette-for-the-dead-princess-death-mix
title: Touhou Koumakyou ~ the Embodiment of the Scarlet Devil - Septette for the Dead Princess (Death-Mix)
description:
Did a short arrangement of Septette for the Dead Princess (from Touhou 6 Koumakyou ~ the Embodiment of the Scarlet Devil) as a "death-mix." I've done too many stage-clear-mixes, so I gotta make another death-mix to compensate, and it's for not only the greatest Touhou theme of all-time (from one of the greatest characters / villains in the series) but also the greatest video game final boss theme of all-time (yes, this is a hill I will forever die on).
Trust me, a full arrangement of this will be made in the future. I promise you that!!


P.S: This also works really well as a game over theme too.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. C Minor (Original Pitch)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. D# Minor (MIDI Pitch)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Enables Miss SFXㅤㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. Disables Miss SFX
